Title: Q Force of Will and Kiss of Ra

Messages.Author: Rodrigo Diaz
Messages.Body:
Sten During <ya...@netg.se> wrote in message news:<3CD8D579...@netg.se>...

According to card text:

Force of Will

Only usable by a tapped vampire.
(D) Bleed with +1 bleed. This vampire takes 2 points of aggravated
damage (damage not preventable), even if the action is blocked. Damage
occurs after the action or combat is resolved.

(Sup) As above, but the (D) bleed is at +2 bleed and the acting
vampire takes 1 point of aggravated damage (damage not preventable).

Kiss of Ra

Only usable when a vampire who does not have Fortitude attempts to
block this acting minion.
The blocking vampire burns 2 blood, and the action is now blocked.

(Sup) As above, and the blocking vampire goes into torpor.

Since (per card text in KoRa) the action is blocked, and Force of
Will's card text states that the vampire takes the agg. damage even if
the action is blocked (an exception to the normal resolution of an
action, the vampire would go to torpor.

Right?

Rod
